# shell

## Classes

### WorkbenchHost

Child-window, command and callback lifetime for the trusted shell the host
composes into its own document. Each child mounts inside the window slot the
shell hands it, so the browser moves, clips and stacks it with that window; the
host never positions a child itself.

#### Implements

- [`TeamWorkbenchHostHandle`](#teamworkbenchhosthandle)

### TeamWorkbenchHostHandle

```ts
type TeamWorkbenchHostHandle = object;
```

Team/Computer/App-directory reads and child-App hosting for the trusted shell.
The host composes the shell into its own top-level document, so the shell runs
with the host's escalated permissions; each child App still runs in its own
sandboxed frame with its own separately resolved approvals.

### WorkbenchChildEvents

```ts
type WorkbenchChildEvents = Readonly<{
  onComputerChoice?: () => Promise<void>;
  onNavigation?: (input) => Promise<void>;
  onAppOpen?: (input) => Promise<void>;
  onAppRole?: (role) => Promise<AppRoleChoice>;
  onSelectionChanged?: () => Promise<boolean>;
  onCommands?: (commands) => Promise<void>;
  onReservedChord?: (input) => Promise<void>;
  onFocus?: (focused) => Promise<void>;
  onNavigationState?: (state) => Promise<void>;
  onStatusItems?: (items) => Promise<void>;
}>;
```

Events a mounted child raises toward its dashboard. A child's permission
requests never reach the dashboard: the host asks the person itself. The host
validates a child's commands against that child's own Release declaration before
forwarding them, so the dashboard can present them but never widen them.

---

### WorkbenchChildHandle

```ts
type WorkbenchChildHandle = object;
```

One mounted child App; every method proxies to its real host-owned mount.

#### Methods

##### setVisibility()

```ts
setVisibility(visibility): Promise<void>;
```

Show or hide the mounted child without changing its identity.

###### Parameters

| Parameter    | Type                      |
| ------------ | ------------------------- |
| `visibility` | `"hidden"` \| `"visible"` |

###### Returns

`Promise`\<`void`\>

##### reconfigure()

```ts
reconfigure(launch): Promise<void>;
```

Update the launch descriptor of the existing mount.

###### Parameters

| Parameter | Type                                            |
| --------- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| `launch`  | [`WorkbenchChildLaunch`](#workbenchchildlaunch) |

###### Returns

`Promise`\<`void`\>

##### requestClose()

```ts
requestClose(): Promise<boolean>;
```

Ask whether the child permits a user-initiated close.

###### Returns

`Promise`\<`boolean`\>

##### requestBack()

```ts
requestBack(): Promise<boolean>;
```

Ask the child to go back one step in its own history; `true` when it did.

###### Returns

`Promise`\<`boolean`\>

##### activateStatus()

```ts
activateStatus(action): Promise<boolean>;
```

Deliver the person's use of a child's status item; `true` when it acted.

###### Parameters

| Parameter | Type              |
| --------- | ----------------- |
| `action`  | `AppStatusAction` |

###### Returns

`Promise`\<`boolean`\>

##### invokeCommand()

```ts
invokeCommand(commandId, input): Promise<WhistleJsonValue | undefined>;
```

Run one of the child's currently presented commands.

###### Parameters

| Parameter   | Type                                                        |
| ----------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
| `commandId` | `string`                                                    |
| `input`     | [`WorkbenchCommandInvocation`](#workbenchcommandinvocation) |

###### Returns

`Promise`\<`WhistleJsonValue` \| `undefined`\>

##### dispose()

```ts
dispose(): Promise<void>;
```

Release the child mount and its resources.

###### Returns

`Promise`\<`void`\>

### WorkbenchPlatformDestination

```ts
type WorkbenchPlatformDestination = Readonly<{
  id: string;
  label: string;
}>;
```

A platform destination the host offers the dashboard, such as opening a host
settings page. The host owns the labels and the navigation; the dashboard only
presents them and asks the host to follow one.

### createBrowserActionHandler()

```ts
function createBrowserActionHandler(
  options,
```

Browser effects stay in the trusted host, bound to one mounted App frame.

| `options.hostWindow` | `Window`                                                                             |
| `options.signal`     | `AbortSignal`                                                                        |

#### Returns

(`request`) => `Promise`\<`AppBrowserActionOutcome`\>
